_comment: Juggernauts guild layer for 3s. gp1 = Stim %, gp2 = Heat % (both out of 100), fed by katmud_lib/juggernaut.py from the prompt (S:[..%] H:[..%]) and GMCP Guild.State; the status line under the bars shows the suit, clan powers and missiles from the same sources. MIP/FFF is gone mud-side (2026-09-15). Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).
Stim heals the juggernaut: low Stim = no healing left (warned like HP). Heat warnings (amber 50%, red 80%) are a GUESS - tune them. Battery only powers the flashlight - not shown.
Attack: 'flipbird <mob>' starts combat with that mob; 'flipbird all' attacks the whole room. It needs an argument. Hunt/Bot send 'flipbird <keyword>', one fight at a time.
